skills.name: ios-environment
skills.description: Locate the .xcodeproj/scheme or Package.swift on a macOS host and enforce build hygiene: confirm the unit-test action exists, clear stale DerivedData, clean state. Triggers: 'set up the iOS build', 'clear DerivedData'.

skills.name: ios-reproduce
skills.description: iOS reproduce recipes: Logic = a failing host-runnable unit test (swift test / xcodebuild test), written first; UI (ASSIST) = build + code-level diagnosis only, never observed on a device. Internal: engine reproduce step.

skills.name: ios-verify
skills.description: iOS verify recipes mirroring reproduce: Logic = failing test passes + suite green; UI (ASSIST) = emit handoff/v0 with a UI LAYER_METHODS proof, ledger stops at candidate. Internal: engine verify step.

skills.name: ios-source-map
skills.description: Symptom -> file hints on an iOS tree: SwiftUI view / UIViewController vs ObservableObject/ViewModel vs storyboard/asset vs logic; crash log -> source. Generic level only. Internal: engine isolate step.
